svg.text: Rows open at 0 / 2 / 5 / 8 / 10 points in that tree • signatures open at 12 points invested • each rank costs 1 point

HOW TO READ: Most nodes need only the row gate. Arrows mark the few nodes with explicit prerequisites. PASSIVE ×N = maximum ranks. Strike morphs are mutually exclusive. Rows count all ranks spent in their own tree.
